postEdit.name: dart-format
postEdit.description: Format any .dart file that was edited

postEdit.name: flutter-analyze-changed
postEdit.description: Run flutter analyze on the feature folder of any edited Dart file
postEdit.command: cd apps/mobile && flutter analyze $(dirname $CLAUDE_EDITED_FILE) 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|warning' | head -20

preWrite.name: secret-scan
preWrite.description: Block writes that contain what look like API keys or secrets
preWrite.command: echo "$CLAUDE_WRITE_CONTENT" | grep -qE '(AIza[A-Za-z0-9_-]{35}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{40,}|xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}|AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16})' && { echo 'BLOCKED: possible secret detected'; exit 1; } || exit 0

preWrite.name: no-print-in-prod
preWrite.description: Warn if a print() is being added outside of test files
preWrite.command: echo "$CLAUDE_WRITE_CONTENT" | grep -qE '^\s*print\(' && echo 'WARNING: print() found. Use packages/core/logger.dart instead.' || exit 0

preWrite.name: domain-layer-purity
preWrite.description: Block Flutter or Firebase imports in domain/ folders
preWrite.command: echo "$CLAUDE_WRITE_CONTENT" | grep -qE "^import 'package:(flutter|firebase_|cloud_firestore|firebase_auth|firebase_storage)" && { echo 'BLOCKED: domain layer cannot import Flutter or Firebase packages (see CLAUDE.md)'; exit 1; } || exit 0

postCommit.name: run-domain-tests
postCommit.description: Run domain unit tests after any commit touching domain/
postCommit.command: cd apps/mobile && flutter test test/features/$(basename $(dirname $(dirname $CLAUDE_EDITED_FILE)))/domain/ 2>&1 | tail -5

firebase-emulator.description: Reserved for later - MCP server wrapping the Firebase emulator for QA integration tests. Do not enable until S4.
